integrity: The theorem is supported by a self-contained gap classification and parameter bijection; verify.py performs separate finite diagnostics, not independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three 1s in finite binary words; no assertion for higher weights or other alphabets. Unindexed earlier equivalent formulations are a residual novelty risk. Computational checks are finite and do not prove the infinite theorem.
title: Three-one privileged binary words: a complete gap classification and partition law
